business.name: Northline Garage Door Co.
business.tagline: Get your garage door moving safely again.
business.description: Northline helps homeowners diagnose garage door problems, compare repair and replacement options, and schedule the right service for the property. Tell us what the door is doing and where you are located to begin.
business.offer: Request an inspection and a clear explanation of available options

services.name: Garage door repair
services.description: Diagnosis and repair options for doors that are stuck, noisy, uneven, slow, or unable to open and close normally.

decisionSupport.scope: Describe whether the door is stuck, uneven, noisy, slow, or unable to open and close normally.
decisionSupport.nextStep: Share the service address and symptoms so the team can confirm coverage and the appropriate repair request.
decisionSupport.preparation: Note whether the door is open or closed and avoid handling springs, cables, or a door that appears unstable.

services.name: Opener service
services.description: Troubleshooting for opener, remote, sensor, and connectivity problems, with the next step explained before work is scheduled.

decisionSupport.scope: Share which wall controls, remotes, sensors, lights, or connected features are not behaving as expected.
decisionSupport.nextStep: The team can use the symptoms and opener details to identify the right service request before scheduling.
decisionSupport.preparation: If it is safe to do so, note the opener brand, indicator lights, and whether the door moves by hand.

services.name: Door replacement
services.description: Help comparing replacement approaches when a door is damaged, worn, or no longer suited to the home.

decisionSupport.scope: Discuss the current door's condition, size, appearance, insulation priorities, and opener compatibility.
decisionSupport.nextStep: Share the address and project goals so available replacement approaches can be discussed for the property.
decisionSupport.preparation: Photos of the existing door and a short list of practical or appearance priorities make the first conversation more useful.

differentiators: The problem is discussed before scheduling

faqs.question: What details help with a service request?
faqs.answer: Share whether the door is open or closed, what you hear or see, the opener type if known, and the property address.

faqs.question: Should I try to move a door with a damaged spring or cable?
faqs.answer: Avoid operating or lifting a door that appears unstable or has damaged spring or cable hardware. Describe the issue and wait for qualified help.

faqs.question: How is service-area coverage confirmed?
faqs.answer: Provide the full property address. The team will confirm current coverage and availability before scheduling.
